How it works FAQ

Send files directly between devices.

PeerDrop is designed to let you share files from your browser. Choose a file, send a link, and let the other person receive it on their device.

See transfer preview How it works

How it works

  1. 01

    Choose a file

    Open PeerDrop in your browser and select the file you want to send.

  2. 02

    Share the link

    Send the transfer link to the person you want to share the file with.

  3. 03

    Receive the file

    The recipient opens the link in their browser and accepts the transfer.

FAQ

What does peer-to-peer mean?

The sender's and recipient's browsers try to connect directly to move the file between their devices.

Do both people need to be online?

Yes. The planned flow requires both people to keep their browser tabs open until the transfer finishes.

Can I send a file from this page?

File sharing is coming soon. The preview shows what a transfer will look like.
